notes: Brief section 18, 'Animal automata and vehicles need': this record carries that list field for field, in the brief's order, exactly as MachineDefinition in godot-rust/src/strategy/production.rs declares it. every_authored_machine_record_loads is what holds the two equal.

Provisional: crew_or_handler_requirement 1 and the fuel and water capacities are small working counts, not balance. Brief section 5.10 is about this number being non-zero at all -- a machine that needs a handler is not free of the scarcest thing the faction has.
